writerFeedback:
The commentary moves briskly through the essentials a periodic update needs, leading with return figures and following with activity, realisations, commitments, and liquidity. The structure is sound and the tone is appropriately factual for an investor audience.

Accuracy is the problem, and it runs through almost every paragraph. 5% in the findings, and the macro context is attributed to 'Russia/Ukraine tensions, lower energy prices' when the source points to Israel/Iran tensions and higher energy prices. 7 million, and gross gearing where the source says net. The shape of the update is fine; the numbers and attributions need to be reset against the source before this can go out.
